experiment: Marginals-only control for FGN continuous state pilot
backbone: frozen public LibriSpeech 960h streaming Zipformer, unchanged
noise_rule: new noise each forecast step, shared across all frame positions and conditional-normalization layers within that step
state_loss: fair CRPS on normalized continuous next encoder states, two members
token_loss: ensemble-mean native token distillation through a frozen differentiable RNN-T joiner
interpretation: FGN-inspired ASR adaptation, not original weather-model reproduction. Continuous states and recurrent memory are fed back without detach; emitted discrete tokens are not the only feedback channel. Future target states are training labels only.
checkpoint_selection: Minimum H4 state CRPS only; token NLL is monitored, not trained or used for selection.
